The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) reached all time high today, Mar, 13 and still has $185.37 target or 3.00 % above today’s $179.97 share price. This indicates more upside for the $913.17 billion company. This technical setup was reported by Barchart.com . If the $185.37 PT is reached, the company will be worth $27.40 billion more.
Trading stocks at an all time highs is usually a winning strategy. An all time high points to a stock which has the most positive fundamentals ever. Even thought the pullback rate is high, if correct risk management is utilized, investors can trade very well such events.
The stock decreased 0.96% or $1.75 $179.97. About 31.21M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 13, 45.78% the S&P500.

After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.08 % negative EPS growth.
